title: lomandra multiflora subsp. dura
intro: Lomandra multiflora subsp. dura, commonly known as Mat Rush, is a type of flowering plant native to Australia. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mat Rush include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and bronchodilator, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Mat Rush include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
